subject.text:
## Direction
- Release: claim export for the six insurers
- Stage: launch
- Target date: 2026-12-15
- Scope: site (home, pricing, contact): launch site that shows founders the claim export; docs (quickstart): launch guide so founders set up exports alone
- Not in scope: slides, video, customer stories

## Because
- Founders lose a week a month to manual claims (context.customer.need)
- Founders arrive from search (focus.reach.channel)

## Watch
- If signups < 20 by 2027-01-15, then review the launch site with the owner.
